title: Servepath Latency Sentinel — percentile slicer with streaming-mode overlay
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Build an interactive dashboard and supporting telemetry pipeline that exposes p50/p95/p99 latency slices by model and route, with an explicit split between streaming (io_mode=streaming) and non-streaming (io_mode=blocking) requests. Dashboard must support cohorting by request shape (prompt tokens, response tokens), show error overlays (5xx/4xx rates) alongside percentiles, and surface trace links for quick drill-down to span-level traces. This ticket covers frontend panels, backend aggregation views, tracing hook updates, and metric/log ingestion tweaks required for accurate attribution.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 per model x route matrix and allows toggling streaming vs non-streaming overlays
Panel supports cohort filter by request_token_bins and conversation_length with consistent legends
Each percentile point links to a filtered trace search (span-level) that includes trace_id and serving_path tags
Metrics pipeline ingests io_mode tag for >99.9% of requests; fallback mapping for legacy requests validated
Error rate heatmap correlated with latency spikes (click-through to error logs and sample requests)
Automated tests for aggregation correctness comparing sample raw traces to computed percentiles run in CI
Rollout plan defined with gradual enablement on staging -> canary -> prod and a rollback mode that hides streaming overlay if ingestion regressions observed
updates: 2025-02-10: Initial ticket created after observability sync; identified need for streaming split in latency surfaces.
2025-02-14: Spike complete — validated sketch queries for p50/p95/p99 using proto metrics. Found missing io_mode tag on ~7% of legacy proxy traffic.
2025-02-18: PR opened to add io_mode propagation to request metadata middleware (github.com/redwood-inference/serving-proxy/pull/3284). Pending review from infra owners.
2025-02-21: Design review with Console UX (Sofia Patel). Agreed on matrix layout with small-multiples for top 10 models by QPS and a cohort selector on left rail.
2025-02-25: Implemented aggregation job in metrics pipeline to compute streaming and blocking percentile histograms. Job runs hourly and in near-real-time for dashboard BETA.

2025-02-28: Discovered discrepancy in p99 for high-token requests; root cause: percentile computation truncation for very long tails. Patch submitted (github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/451).

2025-03-01: Dashboard skeleton merged to staging console (console-redwood/dashboard/servepath-latency). Needs product signoff and test coverage for trace links. Next: add alert rules for p95 > latency SLO on any model-route when accompanied by error rate > 0.5%
